channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-67279 — MikroTik RouterOS
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

item.title: CVE-2026-65660 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2010-1297 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Adobe Flash Player contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2024-21410 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-41993 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain an unspecified vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2023-26359 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could result in code execution in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2022-3038 — Google Chromium Network Service
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Google Chromium Network Service contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2022-41128 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Microsoft Windows contains an unspecified vulnerability in the JScript9 scripting language which allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-2817 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 63. Microsoft Internet Explorer cotains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to gain privileges via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2014-3153 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 63. The futex_requeue function in kernel/futex.c in Linux kernel does not ensure that calls have two different futex addresses, which allows local users to gain privileges.

item.title: CVE-2013-7331 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 63. An information disclosure vulnerability exists in Internet Explorer which allows resources loaded into memory to be queried. This vulnerability could allow an attacker to detect anti-malware applications.

item.title: CVE-2022-22960 — VMware Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 63. VMware Workspace ONE Access, Identity Manager and vRealize Automation contain a privilege escalation vulnerability due to improper permissions in support scripts.

item.title: CVE-2015-0666 — Cisco Prime Data Center Network Manager (DCNM)

item.description: Threat Signal 63. The Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) relay subsystem of Cisco IOS and Cisco IOS XE Software contains a vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code and gain full control of an affected system.

item.title: CVE-2022-0995 — Linux Kernel
